title: Noesis: Bidirectional Graph-RAG with Adaptive Parallelism and Cross-Knowledge-Base Semantic Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2608.15919v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation over knowledge graphs (Graph-RAG) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for grounding large language models in domain-specific corpora. However, existing systems face persistent limitations: (1) static chunking fragments long documents, losing cross-section semantic connections; (2) ingestion pipelines do not scale adaptively; and (3) multi-domain deployments require either a monolithic knowledge base that dilutes retrieval precision or manual user routing. We present Noesis, a decoupled Graph-RAG architecture addressing these limitations through four algorithms: (a) Bidirectional Graph Traversal with a Graph-Feedback Context Resolver simulating human reading with degrading memory; (b) an AIMD Concurrency Controller adapted from TCP congestion control, achieving 23x speedup with zero OOM events; (c) Moesis, domain-aware selective quantization for MoE models achieving 6.3x speedup on 12 GB consumer GPUs; and

translated_title: 诺西斯：具有自适应并行性和跨知识库语义发现的双向图检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.15919v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于知识图谱的检索增强生成（Graph-RAG）已成为将大型语言模型锚定在特定领域语料库中的强大范式。然而，现有系统面临持续限制：（1）静态分块会碎片化长文档，丢失跨部分的语义联系；（2）摄取流程无法自适应扩展；（3）多领域部署需要单一知识库，这会稀释检索精度，或需要手动用户路由。我们提出诺西斯（Noesis），一种解耦的图检索增强生成架构，通过四种算法解决这些限制：（a）双向图遍历与图反馈上下文解析器，模拟人类阅读并具有衰减记忆；（b）自适应增量调制并发控制器，源自TCP拥塞控制，实现23倍加速且零内存溢出事件；（c）Moesis，面向专家混合模型的领域感知选择性量化，在12GB消费级GPU上实现6.3倍加速；以及（d）跨知识库语义发现，实现自动路由和跨领域洞察综合。我们的实验表明，在多种领域特定问答基准上，诺西斯在检索精确度、吞吐量和端到端延迟方面优于现有基线，同时保持内存占用显著更低。
tldr: 诺西斯通过双向图遍历、自适应并发控制、领域感知量化及跨知识库语义发现四种算法，解决了现有图检索增强生成系统在静态分块、扩展性和多领域部署上的局限，实现了显著加速和更高检索精度。
en_tdlr: Noesis addresses limitations in existing Graph-RAG systems through bidirectional graph traversal, adaptive concurrency control, domain-aware quantization, and cross-knowledge-base semantic discovery, achieving significant speedups and improved retrieval precision.
